checklist.evidence: The Windows target reservation excludes writers and locks the extended byte range. An independent probe injected an append at the actual ReplaceFileW call boundary: the append was denied, ReplaceFileW completed once, and the final target contained only the accepted AGY content. The focused regression passed.

Criterion evidence now records task scope and invalidates owned, missing-lineage, or overlapping-scope evidence while retaining disjoint evidence. The independent distributed G1/G2/G3 scenario completed three tasks with all criteria PASS and exactly one Astra planner invocation.

Exit, stream, model, cwd, result, and conversation checks moved before mirror synchronization, but synchronization still occurs before several gates that can reject the attempt, including protected-host attestation, evidence persistence, and the post-attempt executable identity recheck.

Replan exhaustion atomically persisted phase=blocked, error_category=blocked, and replan_blocked.json. Independent repeated execute and resume probes both remained blocked and left Astra invocation count unchanged.

blocking_findings.contract_source: Authoritative plan Sections 2, 3, 5 and 10, Milestone 1 T1, and targeted STEP7-F015 requirement
blocking_findings.exact_requirement: Failed, malformed, wrong-identity, or otherwise non-accepted AGY attempts must not synchronize mirror edits into the host candidate.
blocking_findings.concrete_evidence: _run_windows_sandbox_builder synchronizes at lib/hermes_factory_v2.py:4380-4389 and returns. AgyBuilder.run can subsequently reject at protected-host attestation, boundary or conversation-reservation persistence, duplicated result checks, executable identity recheck, or final success-evidence persistence. An independent production-order probe simulated a synchronized valid sandbox result followed by the real post-attempt identity gate; builder.run raised agy_identity_changed while allowed.py retained synced-before-final-identity-check.
blocking_findings.observed_state: The repair prevents nonzero-exit and malformed-stream synchronization, but a later rejection can still leave synchronized mirror content in the host candidate.
blocking_findings.expected_state: Every gate capable of making the AGY attempt non-accepted must complete before host synchronization, or synchronization must be transactionally rolled back when any later gate fails.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks_current_step: A rejected writer attempt can still alter the host-owned candidate, so the AGY acceptance and isolation boundary remains false.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Move all remaining post-run rejection gates, especially protected-state and executable-identity validation plus durable reservation preparation, ahead of synchronization, or add reliable rollback covering every later failure. Add a deterministic regression where a post-sync identity or evidence gate fails and assert the candidate remains byte-identical.

resolved_findings.concrete_evidence: Actual ReplaceFileW-boundary append was excluded and the focused synchronization regression passed.
The disjoint three-task distributed-criterion scenario completed with G1/G2/G3 PASS and one Astra invocation.
BLOCKED state and replan evidence persisted; later execute and resume performed zero additional Astra calls.

next_actions: Close STEP7-F015 by ensuring no host synchronization survives any subsequent attempt-rejection gate, then rerun its focused regression and the full suite.
